facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet arranged in three rows: a large cinematic 'HERO' shot on top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and four detail close-ups along the bottom.
The hero panel shows a single standing figure centered on a wet, rain-slicked walkway or bridge deck with metal railings on both sides, at night in heavy rain.
The figure wears a black zipped jacket over a black crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up boots; the clothing is all in near-black tactical style.
The character's hair is shaved at the sides with a short top section gathered into a small bun or top-knot at the back of the crown.
The hero background is a dark urban street with out-of-focus warm amber and cool white light spots, reflective puddles, and falling rain streaks.
In the hero panel the figure stands facing slightly to their right of frame, head turned to look off to the left of frame with a neutral, set expression, arms hanging at the sides.
The middle row contains three full-body panels of the same figure against a plain dark grey backdrop, labeled 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', and 'BACK'.

In the front view the figure stands straight facing the camera with arms at the sides; the side profile shows the head in near-profile with the top-knot visible; the back view shows the rear of the jacket and trousers.
The bottom row contains four close-up detail panels labeled 'FACE', 'JACKET COLLAR', 'HANDS', and 'BOOTS'.
The face close-up shows a frontal portrait with short dark hair, a defined jaw, and a visible small scar or line through one eyebrow.
The jacket collar close-up shows dark quilted or textured fabric with a strap and metal buckle at the collar.
The hands close-up shows two weathered adult hands with visible veins and knuckles, side by side against a dark background.
The boots close-up shows a pair of black leather lace-up boots with thick soles and worn creases.
The overall treatment is low-key, desaturated, and cinematic, dominated by black, charcoal and dark grey tones, with warmer amber light accents only in the hero panel.
Legible on-screen text in the image reads: 'HERO', 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', 'BACK', 'FACE', 'JACKET COLLAR', 'HANDS', 'BOOTS'.

limitations: Still image: no motion, camera movement, audio, or dialogue can be established.
